title: helianthemum marifolium var. oblongifolium
intro: Helianthemum marifolium var. oblongifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the Rockrose family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and pain. The health benefits of Rockrose are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as sedative and antispasmodic effects, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. The bioactive constituents in Rockrose have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its potential health benefits.
